[validate_grouper()] sanity-checks contract (right output length, groups distinct input values) small synthetic input run real data — wiring something new.
code: # A trivial custom grouper: fixed ppm tolerance, but reject a merge if the # combined evidence is too thin (n < 3) - contrived, just to show the shape. sparse_aware_grouper <- function(ppm = 20, min_n = 3L) {   force(ppm); force(min_n)   function(mz, intensity = NULL, target_mz = NULL, scan = NULL, ms1_int = NULL) {     if (length(mz) < min_n) return(seq_along(mz))  # too little evidence: don't merge anything     fast_1D_upgma_grouping_cpp(mz, maxDiff = 1e-6 * target_mz * ppm)   } }  validate_grouper(sparse_aware_grouper())  stats_custom <- process_pseudo_spec(raw, mz_target = mz_target,                                     grouper = sparse_aware_grouper(ppm = 20)) nrow(stats_custom) #> [1] 633
